subject: 401 error
resolution: Regenerate API key and update Authorization header

subject: Export fails
description: CSV export times out for 1 year range
resolution: Export in 30-day ranges

subject: Invite missing
description: New member did not receive invite email
resolution: Check spam and resend invite

subject: Rate limit
resolution: Wait 60 seconds or upgrade plan

subject: SSO unavailable
description: SSO option not visible on Free plan
resolution: Upgrade to Pro or Enterprise

subject: Webhook not received
resolution: Verify signature uses raw body and whsec_ secret and endpoint returns 2xx

subject: SSO login loop
description: User redirected repeatedly between IdP and Acme
resolution: Sync IdP clock with NTP (drift over 90 seconds)

subject: 2FA code rejected
resolution: Sync device clock and rescan QR code

subject: File upload fails
resolution: Compress file or upgrade plan (25 MB Free / 1 GB Pro / 5 GB Enterprise)

subject: Search missing results
description: Recent tasks do not appear in search
resolution: Wait a few minutes for the search index to catch up

subject: Import column error
resolution: Use template columns title

subject: Webhook duplicates
description: Handler receives the same event twice
resolution: Make handler idempotent using the event id

subject: Rate limit on Pro
resolution: Reduce frequency or request a custom limit on Enterprise

subject: Restore request
resolution: Owner emails support@acme.example to restore from daily backup into a restored workspace

subject: Data residency
resolution: Create workspace in eu-west region; residency cannot be changed later

subject: Pagination cap
description: API never returns more than 100 items
resolution: Page with limit and offset until data array is empty

subject: API key leaked
resolution: Regenerate key immediately and rotate the secret in CI

subject: Audit log access
resolution: Available on Enterprise under Settings > Audit Logs

subject: Viewer permissions
resolution: Viewers are read-only; assign the Member role instead

subject: Invite pending
description: Invite not accepted after a week
resolution: Resend invite; invites expire after 14 days

subject: Storage quota reached
resolution: Free up space or upgrade to Pro for 100 GB

subject: SLA credit request
resolution: Enterprise submits credit request within 30 days

subject: Slack integration delay
resolution: Known issue for large workspaces; see Known Issues

subject: Comment history
description: Need to view an edited comment
resolution: Comment edit history is kept 30 days; contact support

subject: API key expiry
resolution: Check optional expiry date set on the key in Settings > API Keys
